name: My Teacher is a Futanari
source:
Math really isn't your strong suit, and with your grades at an all-time low, you're going to have to do something to change that.

You aren't exactly your Teacher's favorite, so convincing her to help you out might take some doing.

Are you up to the challenge?

[From [url=https://owlyboi.itch.io/my-teacher-is-a-futanari]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
数学确实不是你的强项，而且由于你的成绩处于历史最低水平，你必须采取一些措施来改变这一点。

你并不是老师最喜欢的人，所以说服她帮助你可能需要一些努力。

你准备好迎接挑战了吗？

[来自[url=https://owlyboi.itch.io/my-teacher-is-a-futanari]Itch.io[/url]]
